story_text: As a user, I want to see my profile information after logging in so that I can confirm my account details.

positive.title: Getting Profile Information
positive.expected_result: The user's profile information is displayed correctly, including name, email, and other relevant details.

positive.title: Validating Profile Information Display
steps: 3. Observe the profile information displayed.(e.g., name, email, and other relevant details)
positive.expected_result: The user's profile information is displayed correctly, including name, email, and other relevant details.

positive.title: Profile Information Display with Updated Details
steps: 3. Update profile information (e.g., change name or email).
4. Save the changes and refresh the profile page.
positive.expected_result: The updated profile information is displayed correctly, reflecting the changes made by the user.

positive.title: Profile Information Display with Incomplete Details
steps: 3. Observe the profile information displayed when some details are missing (e.g., Phone number).
positive.expected_result: The profile page handles incomplete details gracefully, displaying available information and indicating missing details appropriately.

positive.title: Profile Information Display across Different devices
steps: 3. Observe the profile information displayed on different devices (e.g., desktop, mobile, tablet).
positive.expected_result: The profile information is displayed correctly and is responsive across different devices, ensuring a consistent user experience regardless of the device used to access the profile page.

negative.title: Profile Information Not Displayed After Login
steps: 3. Observe the profile information displayed.(e.g., name, email, and other relevant details)
negative.expected_result: The user's profile information is displayed correctly, including name, email, and other relevant details.

negative.title: Profile Information Display with Incorrect Details
steps: 3. Observe the profile information displayed.(e.g., name, email, and other relevant details)
negative.expected_result: The user's profile information is displayed correctly, including name, email, and other relevant details.

negative.title: Profile Information Display with Incomplete Details
steps: 3. Observe the profile information displayed when some details are missing (e.g., Phone number).
negative.expected_result: The profile page handles incomplete details gracefully, displaying available information and indicating missing details appropriately.

edge.title: Display profile with maximum length field values
steps: 3. Update profile information with maximum length field values (e.g., name with 255 characters, email with 255 characters).
4. Save the changes and refresh the profile page.
edge.expected_result: The profile information is displayed correctly, even when field values reach their maximum length limits.

edge.title: Display profile immediately after login under slow network conditions
steps: 1. Log in with valid credentials under simulated slow network conditions.
2. Navigate to the profile page immediately after logging in.
3. Observe the profile information displayed.(e.g., name, email, and other relevant details)
edge.expected_result: The profile information is displayed correctly, even under slow network conditions, ensuring that users can access their profile details without significant delays.

edge.title: Display profile after session timeout and re-login
steps: 2. Wait for the session to timeout.
edge.expected_result: The profile information is displayed correctly after re-login, ensuring that users can access their profile details even after a session timeout.
